rationale: The timed ritual qṣoyo within the Eucharist denotes bread-breaking; the current Hostie feiern is broader and obscures the specific action already identified by the inherited example translation.

summary: qṣoyo is an action nominal filed under Infinitiv, governed by the time expression čax du. The priest and bread are implicit in this local ritual context.

The gloss is clarified within existing sense 1; neither a general secular breaking sense nor new finite-form evidence is supplied. The example is already cited and remains unchanged. No idiomatic phrase is added.
Does qṣy also denote the whole Eucharist in ordinary Turoyo, beyond this specifically timed bread-breaking step? Further examples are needed before widening the revised gloss.
